messages:
maya: Hey team — SableBridge just sent an RFI. They want a short POC to validate migration throughput (~10k reqs/min), answers on BYOK/KMS, and pricing for a dedicated pool. I uploaded the RFI & questionnaire: https://drive.google.com/sablebridge-rfi. Need an internal response + capability matrix by EOD Fri. Who can own throughput numbers and the POC pricing?

sam: I can own the capability matrix & written RFI responses. Can someone drop expected dataset size / avg tokens per request? That will change recommended infra.

linda: I can coordinate the POC logistics with the customer (scheduling, access, contact info). I'll confirm their expected traffic pattern — asking them for a sample CSV now.

ravi: Quick note from runtime: 10k reqs/min is doable but depends on avg tokens and concurrency. Rough calc: assume 8 tokens/req -> ~80k tokens/sec sustained -> needs dedicated pool (4x A100-ish with batching). Cold-start & KV cache warmup will affect the first 5–10 mins. For a short POC we can throttle traffic or ramp. Also quantized 4-bit model variants can reduce GPU count.

sam: good, include the model family they expect to use. Are they planning to run our Redwood-verified Llama2-70B float32 or a quantized variant?

maya: SableBridge said they want parity with their current 3-token avg latency target; they didn't specify model exactly. I'm pushing them for the model name and sample traffic.

jen: Security: we support customer-managed keys via KMS (AWS/GCP) and BYOK flows for Private deployments. For hosted Dedicated we can integrate with customer KMS with an addendum — HSM-level attestations need legal approval. Also: we'll need to confirm their data residency & retention requirements. I'll draft a short answer for the questionnaire.

linda: tagging legal — @jen please send the security Q doc to Legal (Iccia) once you have the draft. Iccia will check if we need an addendum for HSM/BYOK.

ops-bot: deploy-notice: created doc stub at /docs/sales/sablebridge-poc-stub (auto).

sam: Pricing draft: for a 2-week dedicated POC (reserved capacity + support) propose $45k flat + $5k setup (ingress/bench infra). If they want hourly/burst we can quote an alternative. Need engineering confirmation for the GPU count before finalizing.

ravi: Confirming engineering: for the 10k/min steady target with 8 tokens/req and latency SLO ~200–300ms, estimate 4x A100 (or equivalent A10G x6) + 1 SRE oncall for POC. If they accept quantized model we can drop to 2x A100.

maya: perfect — sam, can you put those numbers in the capability matrix and mark the assumptions (tokens/latency/model quantization)? I'll send to the customer once legal signs off.

sam: will do. Sharing draft matrix: https://sheets.example.com/sablebridge-matrix (edit).

jen: added security questionnaire answers in the drive doc (see Q3 about BYOK + Q8 on retention).

linda: Customer responded with sample traffic pattern. Uploading CSV now to the drive link.

maya: OK — next steps: (1) sam finalizes matrix + pricing with ravi notes, (2) jen finishes security answers + legal review, (3) linda schedules POC window after customer confirms model and signs SOW. Thanks all — aiming to send official RFI response by Friday EOD. :thumbsup:

ravi: ack. I'll be on standby for any perf tests during the POC.

sam: ack, will ping if I need clarification on assumptions.

jen: ack, looping in Iccia for legal.

linda: ack — will confirm calendar once SOW draft is ready.

maya: thanks everyone!
